principles: No automatic third-party egress without an explicit capability grant.
Credentials are injected by secret managers and never encoded in URLs, prompts, logs or source.
User-directed browser targets are mission-scoped and are not converted into standing allowlist entries.

gstack.note: gstack egress ledger is forensic evidence, not a network firewall; PEFY network policy remains authoritative.

externalMcp.rule: Disabled unless the mission routes to the capability and its auth/policy gate passes.
